segments.ja319:1.1: Susukhaṃ vata jīvāmi, labhāmi ceva bhuñjituṃ;
segments.ja319:1.3: Paripantheva tiṭṭhāmi, kā nu bhante gatī mama.
segments.ja319:2.1: Mano ce te nappaṇamati, pakkhi pāpassa kammuno;
segments.ja319:3.1: Ñātako no nisinnoti, bahu āgacchate jano;
segments.ja319:3.3: Paṭicca kammaṃ phusati, tasmiṃ me saṅkate mano.
segments.ja319:4.1: Na paṭicca kammaṃ phusati, mano ce nappadussati;
